hypotheses.justification: The statement mentions only FiniteGroupPresentation G (which needs Group and TopologicalSpace), CompactSpace G and TotallyDisconnectedSpace G, so T2Space is not needed to elaborate it. The forward direction never uses it: it only transports compactness and total disconnectedness along the homeomorphism P.equiv.symm. The reverse direction uses it only through `ProfiniteGrp.of G`, whose signature is `[Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]` (Mathlib's docstring says Hausdorff can be omitted for this reason). Mathlib's `TotallyDisconnectedSpace.t1Space` gives T1 from total disconnectedness. `IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace` gives regularity. T1 gives T0, so `instT3Space` applies, and `T3Space.t25Space` then `T25Space.t2Space` give T2Space. So the theorem remains true and provable with the same proof after deleting `[T2Space G]`.
